articles.title: Is human extinction really on the table in the AI race?
articles.summary: In his encyclical last month, Pope Leo XIV addressed the dangers of Artificial Intelligence (AI), stating it must be "disarmed." He clarified this means preventing AI from dominating humanity, rather than rejecting the technology itself. This papal perspective highlights the global discourse on ethical AI development and responsible control, emphasizing the need to ensure technology serves mankind and prevents its unchecked influence.
